title: MCNL v1 is a community adapter for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511
summary: The ScottzillaSystems card presents MCNL v1 as a community adapter for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511. Its approximately 563 MB download is an adapter, not a complete model installation; broader-content behavior remains a distributor claim, and no controlled operation test was established.
research_notes:
Treat the download as an adapter dependency of Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, not a standalone 563 MB installation.

Do not infer a hardware minimum from adapter size; retain the exact base checkpoint and adapter identity in the workflow record.
